title: Pragmatica pairs ~80 consultants with 20-plus years of banking process digitalisation
content:
Pragmatica AG is recorded at roughly 80 consultants with more than 20 years of banking and insurance process digitalisation, operating from Switzerland with EU, Singapore and Hong Kong presence. Two attributes in that line matter, and they rarely appear together in this sweep.

The first is size. Almost every other Flowable partner in the cohort is flagged as enterprise scale or a committee sale — adesso at 11,000-plus, ELCA at 2,200-plus, Nortal at 2,500-plus, Fincons at 1,700-plus. At 80 consultants Pragmatica is in the band where one delivery lead can commit without an alliance review, which is the practical definition of a workable first design partner.

The second is depth in the right vertical. Twenty years of process digitalisation for banks and insurers is exactly the client base where who approved this, under which rule is already a funded question, and the firm has been selling into it long enough to know where the existing tooling stops. The row is nonetheless carried at priority 3, and the record notes the city is not published — a small gap, and cheap to close given the sweep has not been imprint-swept. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18.
